title: services.packages.adjust_check params
description: Read-only pre-check of adjusting a sold voucher (services#118): does :grant_id exist here and is it live? Returns the business reason (grant_not_found | already_voided), and whether it can take sessions (can_add_uses: it has a session limit) and days (can_extend: it expires). It does not mutate; the transactional authority is still services.packages.adjust_grant.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant to adjust.
